note: Complete public scientific-checker bank. Inactive unless SCIBENCH_TRIGGER_LOG is set.

checkers.alarm: max|D D^T - I| or |det D - 1| exceeds a tolerance of 64*eps*(2k+1)*(1+2*pi*k+k*max|angle|), with eps the coarser of the output dtype and torch's default dtype.
checkers.invariant: D(alpha,beta,gamma) is a real orthogonal matrix with determinant +1.
checkers.precondition: Integer degree k >= 0 and finite Euler angles of magnitude <= 1e6.
checkers.rationale: A non-orthogonal 'rotation' rescales equivariant features and breaks rotational equivariance.
checkers.scientific_quantity: Wigner D-matrix of an SO(3) irrep

checkers.alarm: max|D(a,b,g) D(-g,-b,-a) - I| exceeds twice the EQ-001 tolerance, scaled by eps(angle dtype)/eps(D) when the angles are coarser than D (range reduction runs in the angle dtype).
checkers.invariant: D(alpha,beta,gamma) composed with D(-gamma,-beta,-alpha) is the identity (the inverse rotation).
checkers.observation_point: Before wigner_D returns; re-calls wigner_D with all three angles negated and reversed.
checkers.precondition: Integer degree k >= 0 and finite Euler angles of magnitude <= 1e6.
checkers.rationale: The representation must satisfy the group law; otherwise rotating and un-rotating a feature does not return it.
checkers.scientific_quantity: Wigner D-matrix of an SO(3) irrep

checkers.alarm: Skew-symmetry or closure residual max|[G_a,G_b] - sum_c f_abc G_c| exceeds 64*eps*(k+1)^2, with structure constants f_abc read from the degree-1 generators.
checkers.invariant: The three real generators of degree k are skew-symmetric and obey the same commutation relations as the degree-1 generators.
checkers.precondition: Integer degree k >= 1.
checkers.rationale: Generators of different degrees must represent one and the same algebra, or irreps are mutually inconsistent.
checkers.scientific_quantity: so(3) Lie-algebra generators of degree k

checkers.alarm: max|sum_a G_a^2 + k(k+1) I| exceeds 64*eps*(k+1)^3 + 64*eps64.
checkers.invariant: The sum of squares of the three generators equals -k(k+1) times the identity.
checkers.precondition: Integer degree k >= 0.
checkers.rationale: J^2 = j(j+1) is the defining spectral invariant of angular momentum.
checkers.scientific_quantity: quadratic Casimir (J^2) of an SU(2) irrep

checkers.alarm: max|R R^T - I| exceeds 192*eps_dtype or |det R - 1| exceeds 576*eps_dtype.
checkers.invariant: exp(w) is a proper rotation: orthogonal with determinant +1.
checkers.precondition: Finite axis-angle vectors of magnitude <= 1e6.
checkers.rationale: A map that is not onto SO(3) corrupts every lifted group element.

checkers.alarm: max|exp(log R) - R| exceeds 64*eps_dtype*(1 + pi/gap^2) + 4*orthogonality residual (floored at 1e-9), with gap = pi - angle (log conditioning near the cut locus).
checkers.invariant: exp(log(R)) = R.
checkers.observation_point: Before SO3.log returns; re-calls SO3.exp on the result.
checkers.precondition: Rotation matrices (orthogonality residual <= 1e-3) with rotation angle at least 0.05 rad below pi.
checkers.rationale: log and exp are inverse charts of the same group; a mismatch changes the group element the model sees.
checkers.scientific_quantity: axis-angle vector of a rotation matrix

checkers.alarm: Relative radial error, relative error of the doubled radial output, or any angle change exceeds 16*eps_dtype.
checkers.invariant: The radial output equals |v|/divide_radius_by; scaling v by 2 doubles the radial output and leaves both angles unchanged.
checkers.observation_point: Before get_spherical_from_cartesian returns; re-calls the function on 2v.
checkers.precondition: Finite vectors whose norms keep squares representable in the working dtype; positive divide_radius_by; the output radius |v|/divide_radius_by (and its double) is a normal number of the dtype.
checkers.rationale: Direction and length must be independent coordinates, or harmonics are evaluated at the wrong angle.

checkers.alarm: max|Q^H Q - I| exceeds 64*eps_dtype*(2k+1).
checkers.invariant: The change-of-basis matrix Q is unitary: Q^H Q = I.
checkers.precondition: Integer degree k >= 0 and a complex output dtype (a real dtype cannot represent the basis change).
checkers.rationale: A non-unitary change between orthonormal bases mixes norms between real and complex harmonics.

checkers.alarm: max|(D_out (x) D_in) Q_J - Q_J D_J| or the off-multiple part of Q_J^T Q_J exceeds 1e-6*(2d_in+1)(2d_out+1).
checkers.invariant: At rotation angles not used to build it, Q_J intertwines D_out (x) D_in with D_J, and Q_J^T Q_J is a multiple of the identity (Schur).
checkers.precondition: Degrees d_in, d_out, J <= 4 with |d_in-d_out| <= J <= d_in+d_out.
checkers.rationale: This is the property that makes the SE(3)-equivariant convolution equivariant.

checkers.alarm: x has the wrong shape, or a block mean deviates from its nucleus by more than 6*stddev/sqrt(batch*n_k) + 64*eps*scale.
checkers.invariant: x has shape (batch, total electrons, 1, 3) and the electrons of block k, initialised around nucleus k, have mean within 6*stddev/sqrt(batch*n_k) of that nucleus.
checkers.precondition: Nucleus array (n,3), integer per-nucleus counts >= 0, finite stddev >= 0.
checkers.rationale: Wrong electron counts or placement change the system's charge neutrality and starting wavefunction.

checkers.alarm: The result is non-finite, below min d*(1 - 64*eps*n_nuclei), or above max d*(1 + 64*eps*n_nuclei), eps being that of the coarsest floating dtype among the electron positions and the nucleus positions (eps64 for float64/non-array inputs).
checkers.invariant: For each electron the harmonic mean over nuclei lies in [min distance, max distance].
checkers.precondition: Electron positions with all electron-nucleus distances positive and finite, and their squares normal numbers (neither underflowing nor overflowing) in the coarsest floating dtype among the electron and nucleus positions.
checkers.rationale: It sets the width of the asymmetric proposal; a value outside the distance range is not a length scale of the system.

checkers.alarm: The accepted-move ratio of that re-run differs from 1 by more than 1e-12.
checkers.invariant: For a constant target density and symmetric proposal every move is accepted.
checkers.observation_point: Before move returns; re-runs the same configuration on a copy of x with a constant target (global RNG state saved and restored).
checkers.precondition: Symmetric simultaneous moves with 1..200 steps and finite stddev.
checkers.rationale: Detailed balance reduces to acceptance 1 here.

checkers.alarm: Either difference deviates by more than 64*eps*(coordinates*(1+max|log sigma|) + half the quadratic term).
checkers.invariant: At y = mu, doubling sigma lowers the log-density by (number of scalar coordinates per batch element)*log 2; moving y from mu lowers it by half the sum of squared standardised displacements.
checkers.observation_point: Before log_prob_gaussian returns; re-calls it with y = mu and with sigma doubled.
checkers.precondition: 4-D y, mu and a positive sigma broadcastable to y with |log sigma| <= 50.
checkers.rationale: The asymmetric Metropolis ratio is built from these densities.

checkers.alarm: max|R R^T - I| or |det R - 1| exceeds 192*eps64.
checkers.invariant: The returned matrix is a proper rotation: R^T R = I and det R = +1.
checkers.precondition: No arguments.
checkers.rationale: A non-rotation corrupts augmented molecular coordinates.

checkers.alarm: A pairwise-distance or origin-radius change exceeds 192*eps64*max|coordinate|, or the shapes differ.
checkers.invariant: Rotation preserves all intra-molecule distances and every atom's distance from the origin.
checkers.precondition: Finite coordinate arrays (n,3), n <= 300, with 1e-100 <= max|coordinate| <= 1e100.
checkers.rationale: Rotation must not deform the molecule.

checkers.alarm: Any of the three comparisons differs by more than 64*eps/max(sin(theta), 1e-8) (arccos conditioning), eps being that of the coarsest floating input dtype (eps64 for float64/non-array inputs).
checkers.invariant: The angle equals atan2(|a x b|, a.b), is symmetric in its arguments and is unchanged by scaling either vector.
checkers.observation_point: Before angle_between returns; re-calls it with swapped and with scaled (2a, 4b) arguments.
checkers.precondition: Finite nonzero vectors of equal length with magnitudes between 1e-100 and 1e100; for floating input dtypes the squared norms are normal numbers of that dtype (no overflow or underflow).
checkers.rationale: Interaction geometry (hydrogen bonds, stacking) is defined through this angle.

checkers.alarm: Moved-copy difference exceeds 256*eps64*(max|coordinate| + |translation|), or transpose difference exceeds 8*eps64*max distance.
checkers.invariant: Distances are invariant under a common rigid motion and D(A,B) equals D(B,A) transposed.
checkers.observation_point: Before compute_pairwise_distances returns; re-calls it on a rigidly moved copy (translation scaled to the cloud) and on swapped arguments.
checkers.precondition: Finite coordinate arrays (m,3) and (n,3) with 1e-100 <= max|coordinate| <= 1e100.
checkers.rationale: Distances are the basis of every contact and neighbour definition.

checkers.alarm: Swapped result differs while the angle is more than 1.8e-7 degrees from the threshold, or a True result becomes False at 1.5c, or a False result becomes True at 0.5c.
checkers.invariant: The predicate is symmetric in the two vectors (away from the threshold) and monotone in the cutoff.
checkers.observation_point: Before is_angle_within_cutoff returns; re-calls it with swapped vectors and with cutoff 1.5c or 0.5c.
checkers.precondition: Finite nonzero vectors whose squared norms are normal numbers (neither underflowing nor overflowing) in the coarsest floating input dtype, cutoff in (0,180] degrees.
checkers.rationale: A hydrogen-bond linearity criterion must not depend on vector order or shrink when the tolerance grows.

checkers.alarm: Some bound of the result lies outside box1 or box2.
checkers.invariant: The intersection is contained in both boxes.
checkers.precondition: Two boxes that overlap on every axis.
checkers.rationale: Binding-pocket regions are combined through box algebra.

checkers.alarm: An input box is covered by no output box, or an output bound exceeds the extreme input bound on some axis.
checkers.invariant: Every input box lies inside some output box, and no output box leaves the hull of the inputs.
checkers.precondition: A non-empty list of valid boxes and threshold in [0,1].
checkers.rationale: A dropped box removes a region from all downstream featurisation.

checkers.alarm: sin(angle between returned normal and best-fit normal) exceeds 64*eps64/sin(theta0) + 4*planarity deviation/(shorter edge*sin(theta0)).
checkers.invariant: The returned normal is parallel to the best-fit plane normal.
checkers.precondition: Ring of >= 3 atoms planar to within 1e-6 of its diameter (best-fit plane) whose first three atoms are not nearly collinear (sin of the angle at the first atom >= 1e-3).
checkers.rationale: Stacking and cation-pi tests are defined against this normal.
checkers.scientific_quantity: normal of an aromatic ring plane

checkers.alarm: The contact sets differ in any distance bin.
checkers.invariant: The contact set is unchanged by a common rigid motion of both fragments.
checkers.observation_point: Before compute_hydrogen_bonds returns; re-calls it on rigidly moved copies with all arguments forwarded.
checkers.precondition: Fragments with coordinates consistent with the supplied distance matrix; no distance, hydrogen distance or angle within rounding of its threshold, rounding being taken at the eps of the coarsest floating coordinate dtype (angle margin 1e3*eps*scale/|v|).
checkers.rationale: A bond definition must not depend on the laboratory frame.

checkers.alarm: The transposed contact sets differ in any distance bin.
checkers.invariant: Exchanging the two fragments (and transposing the distance matrix) returns the transposed contact set.
checkers.observation_point: Before compute_hydrogen_bonds returns; re-calls it with fragments swapped.
checkers.precondition: As DC-NC-002.
checkers.rationale: Donor and acceptor roles are not tied to the protein or ligand side.

checkers.alarm: A returned contact has charge product >= 0 (same sign or zero).
checkers.invariant: Both atoms of a salt-bridge contact carry charges of strictly opposite sign.
checkers.precondition: Contacts returned for fragments with finite partial charges.
checkers.rationale: A salt bridge is the attraction of opposite charges.

checkers.alarm: Either re-call returns a different boolean.
checkers.invariant: The result is unchanged by a common rotation+translation and by flipping the ring normal.
checkers.observation_point: Before is_cation_pi returns; re-calls it on a rigidly moved copy and with the normal negated.
checkers.precondition: Finite 3-vectors whose squared cation-center distance and squared normal norm are normal numbers (neither underflowing nor overflowing) in the coarsest floating input dtype, positive distance cutoff, angle cutoff in (0,90); no distance or angle within rounding of its threshold, rounding being taken at the eps of the coarsest floating input dtype (angle margin 1e3*eps*scale/|v|).
checkers.rationale: The contact definition must depend only on relative geometry and the ring axis, not its orientation sign.

checkers.alarm: Either kept-atom list differs from the original (after undoing the reordering).
checkers.invariant: The kept atoms are unchanged by a rigid motion of the whole complex and by reordering the fragments.
checkers.observation_point: Before get_contact_atom_indices returns; re-calls it on a moved copy and on reversed fragments.
checkers.precondition: At least two fragments, <= 3000 atoms, no inter-fragment distance within 1e-9*scale of the cutoff.
checkers.rationale: Trimming a complex to its contact region must not depend on frame or fragment order.

checkers.alarm: The output atomic numbers or coordinates differ from the input's non-hydrogen atoms, or a hydrogen remains.
checkers.invariant: The output has exactly the input's non-hydrogen atoms, in order, with their coordinates, and no hydrogen.
checkers.precondition: Coordinates matching the molecule's atom count.
checkers.rationale: Atoms must be conserved when a structure is simplified.

checkers.alarm: The merged element/charge sequence or coordinates differ from the concatenation.
checkers.invariant: The merged fragment's atoms (element, partial charge, coordinates) are the concatenation of the inputs' atoms.
checkers.precondition: A non-empty list of fragments.
checkers.rationale: Atoms and charge must be conserved when fragments are combined.

checkers.alarm: max|M' - M| exceeds 64*eps64*(max|coordinate| + |translation|)/min distance*max|M|.
checkers.invariant: The matrix is unchanged by a rigid motion of every conformer.
checkers.observation_point: Before coulomb_matrix returns; re-calls it on a molecule copy with moved conformers.
checkers.precondition: Non-randomised matrices of a molecule with conformers and no atom pair closer than 1e-3 angstrom.
checkers.rationale: A structure descriptor must not depend on the laboratory frame.

checkers.alarm: Any off-diagonal entry deviates from Z_i Z_j a0/r_ij by more than a relative 1e-8 + 64*eps64*(1+scale/min distance).
checkers.invariant: Off-diagonal entries obey Coulomb's law in atomic units: M_ij * r_ij / a0 = Z_i Z_j, with a0 the CODATA Bohr radius.
checkers.precondition: As DC-CM-001.
checkers.rationale: A unit or constant error rescales every descriptor.

checkers.alarm: Sorted spectra differ by more than 256*eps64*n*max|lambda|, or magnitudes increase along the output.
checkers.invariant: The spectrum is unchanged by relabelling atoms and is ordered by decreasing magnitude.
checkers.observation_point: Before _featurize returns; re-calls it on a renumbered molecule.
checkers.precondition: Non-randomised molecule with conformers and no atom pair closer than 1e-3 angstrom.
checkers.rationale: A permutation-invariant descriptor must not depend on atom order.

checkers.alarm: A matrix has different sorted entries, different sorted diagonal, loses symmetry, or has a different spectrum (tolerance 64*eps64*n*max|M|).
checkers.invariant: Every randomised matrix is a simultaneous row and column permutation of the input.
checkers.precondition: Exactly symmetric finite matrices, n <= 300.
checkers.rationale: Randomisation must only relabel atoms.

checkers.alarm: mass in u lies outside [lightest, heaviest] isotope mass by more than a relative 1e-6.
checkers.invariant: The mass (converted with the CODATA m_u/m_e ratio) lies between the lightest and heaviest known isotope mass of the element.
checkers.precondition: Integer Z in 1..118 for which RDKit knows an isotope.
checkers.rationale: A mass outside the isotope range is not a mass of that element.

checkers.alarm: The returned period differs from the Madelung-derived period.
checkers.invariant: The period equals the principal quantum number of the outermost shell filled in Madelung (n+l, n) order.
checkers.precondition: Integer Z in 1..118.
checkers.rationale: Periodicity underlies shell-structure features.

checkers.alarm: The two atomic numbers differ.
checkers.invariant: The atomic number equals RDKit's atomic number for that symbol.
checkers.observation_point: Before get_atomz returns for a string argument.
checkers.precondition: Element symbols known to RDKit.
checkers.rationale: A wrong Z changes every nuclear charge used downstream.
checkers.scientific_quantity: atomic number of an element symbol

checkers.alarm: Some scaffold appears in two splits.
checkers.invariant: No Bemis-Murcko scaffold (RDKit MurckoScaffold, non-chiral) occurs in more than one of train/valid/test.
checkers.precondition: Datasets whose ids are SMILES strings.
checkers.rationale: A scaffold split exists to prevent scaffold leakage between train and test.

checkers.alarm: A lower split contains a mass above the minimum of the next non-empty split by more than a relative 1e-9.
checkers.invariant: Exact molecular masses are ordered: no train mass exceeds a valid mass and no valid mass exceeds a test mass.
checkers.precondition: Datasets whose ids are valid SMILES strings.
checkers.rationale: The split is defined as extrapolation in molecular weight.
